_meta._comment: Correlated/enriched alerts, 1-year retention via ISM (ism-alerts-365d.json attaches by index pattern, not by a template setting). v4: ai.engine/ai.model added so the dashboard can show which LLM actually produced a verdict (ollama vs stub), see services/ws5-ai/llm_adapter.py. v5 (gap-hunt finding, 2026-08-23): services/ws4-detection/main.py::make_alert() copies `src_endpoint`/`actor` WHOLESALE from the triggering event, which events-common.json maps far more richly (reputation, location, port, hostname, uid, domain) than this template did -- those real fields on real alerts landed in _source but were NOT indexed/searchable/aggregatable in alerts-*, silently, with no error (a dashboard filter on e.g. src_endpoint.location.country works against events-* and returns nothing against alerts-*). Expanded to match. Also dropped the dead `siem.*` block: make_alert() never sets a `siem` key on an alert doc at all (alerts carry `tenant_id`/`sector` as top-level fields instead, per router.py) -- those three properties could never be populated.
